body.name: Full-dimensional exact-target response-tube handle
body.construction: Start with the invertible basis \(B=[v,d_1,\ldots,d_{J-1}]\), where \(d_j\) span \(\ker(c^\top)\). Represent each of \(\pm v\) and \(\pm d_j\) by nonnegative weights on \(\mathcal T_c\); localize the target coordinate with squared compact rational splines approximating \(\phi_{\kappa}^2\), localize every transverse coordinate with endpoint-vanishing rational polynomial densities, and form a permutation-invariant finite-schedule prior. The sought construction must retain exact target regression, join sign cells by weak integration by parts, and stratify counts into local, positive exterior, inactive-arm, and missing-active-arm faces.
